entry.zh:
a. 可遵守的, 可庆祝的, 看得见的, 可辨别的, 观测得到的, 值得注意的, 显著的
n. 感觉到的事物, 现象
entry.tierNote: Project frequency-based study group; not an official CEFR classification or complete level vocabulary

corpusExamples.sentence: The proposed trial addresses an observable process rather than a presumed attitude.
corpusExamples.translation: 建议的试行针对可观察流程，而非假定态度。
corpusExamples.association: literal word occurrence; sense not individually reviewed

corpusExamples.sentence: The investigation should begin with a question the learner can answer responsibly: which observable entrance features make access easier or harder under specified conditions?
corpusExamples.association: literal word occurrence; sense not individually reviewed
